Easy Potatoe Soup.

This makes almost 2 gallons... reduce as needed.

2 cup chopped onions or shallots.

1 cup minced garlic.

2 cup crumbled bacon.

1 gallon chicken stock.

16 cups diced potatoes. Skin on is best.

1 qt. of heavy cream.

1 cup sliced green onions.

Several dashes of your favorite hot sauce.

S & P to taste.

In some oil... bacon fat is best, saute your onions/shallots and garlic. Starting with the onion saute them till almost translucent before adding the garlic.

Add the chicken stock and bacon. Salt and pepper to taste. Bring to a boil stir occasionally.

When the stock comes to a boil add the potatoes, cook at a slow boil until they are soft enough to poke with a fork.

Add the green onion and heavy cream. Bring to a boil, add a thickener, mashed potatoes are the best, instant work in a pinch. For a smoother thickness use a cornstarch slurry.
